summary: I only used #IndieWeb web stuff from 2014-2018 got more involved after looking into the standards used by #OER community... There really aren't any in use but plenty of people making academic careers defining vocabularies and specs no one will use.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: I only used #IndieWeb web stuff from 2014-2018 got more involved after looking into the standards used by #OER community... There really aren't any in use but plenty of people making academic careers defining vocabularies and specs no one will use.
